{{Short description|Argentinian molecular biologist}}
'''Andrés Carrasco''' (1946 in [[Buenos Aires]] &ndash; May 10, 2014) was an [[Argentina|Argentine]] molecular biologist.<ref name="BruceBlumberg2014">{{Cite journal |title=Andrés Carrasco (1946–2014)|url=https://escholarship.org/uc/item/0870953m|journal=[[Developmental Biology (journal)|Developmental Biology]]|last=Blumberg|publisher=eScholarship, University of California|first=Bruce|date=2014|volume=393 |pages=1–2 |doi=10.1016/j.ydbio.2014.07.001 |pmid=25275141 |doi-access=free}}</ref>

== Career ==
He was known for studying the effects of [[glyphosate]] used in [[Roundup (herbicide)|Roundup]] on embryonic development.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DDGSZJLrssY |title=Andres Carrasco - Results of a Case Study of Glyphosate/Roundup |accessdate=1 October 2014 |date=2 July 2012 |publisher=[[University of California at Irvine|The UCI Law Center for Land, Environment, and Natural Resources]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|author1=Alejandra Paganelli|author2=Victoria Gnazzo|author3=Helena Acosta|author4=Silvia L. López|author5=Andrés E. Carrasco|title=Glyphosate-Based Herbicides Produce Teratogenic Effects on Vertebrates by Impairing Retinoic Acid Signaling|url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/abs/10.1021/tx1001749year=2010|journal=Chemical Research in Toxicology|volume=23|issue=10|pages=1586–1595|doi=10.1021/tx1001749|pmid=20695457|year=2010|s2cid=8293731 |hdl=11336/67699|hdl-access=free|url-access=subscription}}</ref> He was president and head scientist of the embryology laboratory (CONICET) of the [[University of Buenos Aires]] (UBA).

== Death ==
On 10 May 2014, Carrasco died in Buenos Aires from a heart attack, aged 67.<ref name="BruceBlumberg2014" /><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.conicet.gov.ar/fallecio-andres-carrasco-investigador-y-ex-presidente-del-conicet-2/ |title=Andrés Carrasco dies, investigator and ex President of CONICET |accessdate=11 May 2014 |date=10 May 2014 |publisher=[[Consejo Nacional de Investigaciones Científicas y Técnicas (Argentina)|CONICET]]}}</ref>
